annotations.title: List your datasheets that have a component twin

description: List the datasheets in your DatasheetVend account that have a Unified Component Model (UCM) digital twin: the facts DatasheetVend already extracted from each datasheet — pins, supply rails, interfaces, registers and whole-part limits — combined across the extraction runs stored for it. Returns each datasheet's exact name, the modules its twin draws on, how many runs it has and when it was last run. Reads stored results only: never extracts, never bills. Needs a DatasheetVend API key. Pass a returned name to datasheetvend_get_component_twin. To twin a datasheet the account has not extracted, use datasheetvend_build_component_twin.

limit.description: How many datasheets to return, newest run first. Default 20.

search.description: Part of the datasheet's file name to filter by, case-insensitive (for example 'ATmega328P').

name: datasheetvend_list_component_twins

datasheet.description: Exact datasheet name — pass it to the get tool

last_run_at.description: ISO time of the newest run

modules.description: Module ids with stored output for this datasheet

never_extracted.description: Twin-ready modules never extracted for this datasheet

runs.description: Extraction runs stored for this datasheet

total.description: Datasheets with a twin that match, before the limit

title: List your datasheets that have a component twin
